title: Bank connections
description: Connect your banks so transactions arrive every day, without uploading PDF statements. Access is read-only.

empty.title: No banks connected yet
empty.body: Connect a bank to keep budgets up to date automatically. Your reviewed PDF statements stay exactly as they are: bank sync only adds transactions after them.

mockNotice: Offline mode: banks are simulated and transactions are generated. Set ENABLE_BANKING_APP_ID and ENABLE_BANKING_PRIVATE_KEY to connect real banks.

dialog.title: Connect a bank
dialog.description: You'll go to your bank's website or app to approve read-only access. We never see your password.
dialog.how: Access lasts up to 180 days (some banks allow 90). We'll remind you before it ends.

status.expiring: Expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

lastError: Last attempt failed. We'll retry on the next sync.
syncLimit: Your bank allows a few updates a day. Next sync tomorrow.
synced: {count, plural, =0 {Up to date. No new transactions.} one {# new transaction added.} other {# new transactions added.}}
disconnectBody: We'll revoke access at your bank and stop syncing. Transactions already added stay in the app. You can import PDF statements for these accounts again from the day after the last synced transaction.

setup.title: Choose what to sync from {bank}
setup.description: Pick the app account each bank account feeds, and the first day to import.
setup.fromAfterPdf: Your reviewed PDF statements cover up to {date}. Earlier days stay as they are.
setup.fromNoPdf: This account has no PDF statements. Banks usually share about 90 days of history.
setup.fromLocked: This account already has synced transactions, so its start date is fixed.
setup.done: {count, plural, =0 {Bank sync is set up. No transactions to import yet.} one {Bank sync is set up. # transaction imported.} other {Bank sync is set up. # transactions imported.}}

banner.expired: Bank access to {bank} has expired, so its transactions stopped updating.
banner.expiring: Bank access to {bank} ends in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.

mock.title: {bank} (simulated)
mock.body: This is a stand-in for your bank's consent screen. A real bank would ask you to sign in and choose which accounts to share.
